method: The ward baseline was the single most recent contest. This blends the ward's earlier contests in with exponential decay at the half-life below, averaging each party only over the contests it actually stood in and renormalising. Chosen by 5-fold hold-out grouped by council: the half-life is picked on four folds and scored on the fifth.

validation.design: 5-fold by council, half-life selected on the training folds, scored on the held-out fold
validation.note: Every fold independently picked a one-year half-life, and MAE improved in every fold. Winner accuracy improved in four of five, so the share-level gain is the solid part and the winner-level gain is not. A one-year half-life is a mild blend: a contest four years older carries a sixteenth of the weight. Longer half-lives were tested and were worse, which agrees with the separate finding that pre-realignment ward results actively mislead.
